'''Reegas Vance''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gambling/Legends|gambler]] who lived around the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Second Galactic Civil War]]. In [[41 ABY|41.5 ABY]], at the [[Black Hole (Fhost)|Black Hole]] [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] in [[Farpoint]], on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Fhost]], Vance played a game of [[Sabacc/Legends|sabacc]] against [[Earsh]], [[Khedryn Faal]], and [[Flaygin]], using [[Corellian Gambit]] rules. In the final round, he lost to Faal, although the result was due&mdash;unbeknownst to both Faal and Vance&mdash;to the manipulation of nearby [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Jaden Korr]] with [[The Force/Legends|the Force]]. A [[Brawl in the Black Hole|deadly brawl]] then broke out in the cantina over the coordinates to a site located by Faal. In the aftermath of the brawl Vance was [[Death/Legends|killed]] by [[Kell Douro]] just as he found the storage crystal with the coordinates.

==Behind the scenes==
Reegas Vance appeared in [[Paul S. Kemp]]'s first ''[[Star Wars]]'' novel, ''[[Crosscurrent]]'', which was published on [[January 26]], [[2010]].
